cases.question: What is overfitting, and name one fix shown in the slides.
cases.answer:
Overfitting occurs when a model learns the noise in the training data instead of the underlying pattern. As a result, it performs very well on the training set but poorly on new, unseen data.  
One fix shown in the slides is **regularization** (other options include collecting more data or simplifying the model) [1].
